Separate from the analysis engine: changing this file never changes a measurement, score or coaching text.

videos.title: Brilliant posture drill for a better golf swing
videos.creator: SMASH FACTOR GOLF COACHING
videos.match: Alignment pole down the back (head and lower back touching), hinge from the hips, soften the knees, let the arms hang, then grip: the same sequence as the written steps.

videos.title: KNEE FLEX AND HIP BEND | BUILD YOUR SWING IN 30 DAYS || Jared Danford Golf
videos.creator: Jared Danford Golf
videos.match: Too little flex (straight legs) and too much flex (binds the hips), then a simple check: hinge from good posture with relaxed legs, fingertips reach the top of the kneecaps. Covers both directions the Knee bend check reports.

videos.title: Distance From Golf Ball At Setup - SUPER IMPORTANT!!
videos.creator: Data Animation
videos.match: Hinge, slight knee flex, let the arms hang straight under the shoulders (about a hand's width from the thighs), then move the feet to the ball rather than the hands; shows too close (crowded) and too far (reaching). Channel identity not confirmed: the coach is not named.

videos.title: Parallel to or Pointed at Drill
videos.creator: mygolfinstructor (Maria Palazzola)
videos.match: Clubs on the ground along the target line; stop at each stage of the backswing and check the shaft is parallel to or pointing at the target line (the plane reference the Plane check uses).

videos.title: Stay in Posture: Chair drill
videos.creator: Peter Knight Golf
videos.match: Chair touching the backside at address; keep contact on the trail hip at the top of the backswing instead of standing up; practise slowly without and then with a club.

videos.title: Improve Your Golf Swing - The Pump Drill
videos.creator: Jim Estes
videos.match: For golfers who throw the club outside at the start of the downswing: to the top, pump down once, back up, pump twice, swing on the third. Arms drop while the trunk stays turned. Face-on camera angle.

videos.title: STOP Early Extension NOW! The "Butt Against the Wall" Golf Drill for a Perfect Posture!
videos.creator: IMAGEN Golf
videos.match: Rear against a wall in posture; trail cheek stays on the wall in the backswing, lead cheek on the wall through impact, so the hips cannot move toward the ball (early extension).

videos.title: Use Your Shadow to Improve Your Swing
videos.creator: MonarchBeachGL
videos.match: Same set-up as the written drill (a ball at the head's shadow) but it only covers the backswing and says to keep the head 'totally still', while the Head check is measured at impact and Swing Guru's coaching says some movement is normal. Not shown until approved.
videos.disabled_reason: Harry 2026-11-09: says keep the head completely still, which conflicts with Swing Guru coaching (some head movement is normal). Written steps are the fallback.
